_comment: Copy this to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored. The Canvas API token never goes in here -- put it in canvas.token or the CANVAS_TOKEN environment variable.
_excluded_courses: Optional. Courses to hide in the picker, matched on course id or any substring of the name. Empty by default; the term filter is usually the better way to narrow the list.
_model: Default model for grading. Changing the dropdown in the UI rewrites this key, so your choice sticks across restarts.
_models: Options offered in the UI dropdown. Any alias the Claude CLI accepts works; add a pinned model id here if you want one.
_grading_concurrency: How many students are graded at once, each one its own claude CLI call. 1-8; anything higher is clamped to 8. This changes how long a section takes, not what it costs -- the trade is against rate limits, which surface as errors on individual students in the job log.
_pseudonymize: Swap student names for tags before any text is sent to Claude: S-001 while grading, Student-1 in the Assistant, where a name you type is swapped out and swapped back on your screen. The lists of who is who stay in data/<course>/ and never leave this machine. See docs/NAMES.md.
_syllabus_policies_path: Optional. A JSON file of the statements every syllabus must mention (ADA, integrity, attendance, Title IX). Empty uses courseforge/knowledge/syllabus-policies.json.
_audit_to_canvas: Keep the record of what the Studio did in your own Canvas user files (Files / courseforge-studio/record), so it outlives this PC. The chained local copy under data/<course>/audit/ is written either way. See docs/RECORD.md.
_audit_sync_s: How often the background upload checks for a month that has changed.
_blender: Blender for .blend submissions. blender_path empty means auto-detect (PATH, standard install dirs, Windows registry). blend_vision sends the rendered contact sheet to the model; vision_model is used for those calls since opus vision costs several times more for no better judgment of form.
_humanize: The second pass. Every piece of prose the Studio writes -- the comment a student reads, the per-criterion rationales, the class summary, the teaching read, the overlap triage, an answered question, an announcement draft, an inbox reply -- goes back through the humanizer skill before it is shown, so it reads as a person wrote it. humanize_model is the editing model; sonnet is enough. humanize_skill_path empty means your installed ~/.claude/skills/humanizer/SKILL.md when present, else the copy bundled in courseforge/knowledge/humanizer.md. A pass that fails keeps the original words.
_humanize_auto_update: Once a day the Studio fetches the current humanizer SKILL.md from its GitHub repository into your per-user folder and keeps it only if it is a valid, newer skill file. The next grade uses it: no click, no restart. Turn this off to freeze the skill at whatever copy is installed. humanize_update_s is the check interval in seconds.
_schedule_max_age_min: The term schedule refetches from Canvas in the background when the cached copy is older than this many minutes. The cache is shown immediately either way, with its age in the footer.
_grade_scale: Minimum percent for each letter grade; below the lowest is an F. Used by the insight charts and the curve preview. Change to match your institution.
_allow_canvas_writes: A hard read-only lock. Left true, because the tool exists to change live courses -- and every single write is refused once, shown to you in full, and only sent when you confirm that exact change. Set this to false to bolt the doors shut anyway: nothing can reach Canvas, and the drafting, planning and export features all still work.
_pull_interval_s: While an assignment is open, re-read its Canvas grades this often (seconds) so grades pushed from another machine show up here. Never overwrites unpushed local work; disagreements are shown as conflicts for you to settle. 0 turns the timer off (the pull when you open an assignment still runs).
_assignment_max_age_min: Opening an assignment syncs it from Canvas by itself. One that has never been synced always does; one synced more recently than this many minutes opens straight away. Files already downloaded are not fetched twice, so a re-sync is mostly API calls. 0 syncs on every open.
_state_to_canvas: Keep the standing roster and student notes in your Canvas user files (Files / courseforge-studio/state) so a second computer can pick them up. Hydrate still runs if allow_canvas_writes is false; upload does not.
_state_sync_s: How often the background replica checks the roster.
_handoff_folder: Canvas user-files folder for in-progress grade drafts. Legacy name canvas-grader; do not put names.json or map.json here.
_handoff_auto: Once an assignment has been handed off, keep rewriting the Canvas copy as you edit.
_handoff_debounce_s: Seconds to wait after an edit before rewriting the handoff draft.
